design:
Child epic of the nuclear refinery programme (bn op-upme).

**Fidelity target: Crude estimate now, Engineering model target**

A rigorous MESH crude-column path already exists (`solve_crude_column`,
`CrudeColumnConfig`, `CrudeColumnResult`). **Dogfood and validate it** before
extending.

## Preserve the documented limitation

The crate already states, correctly: *"Atmospheric column only - no vacuum
tower, no pre-flash, no crude furnace, no pump-arounds, and no steam stripping.
It is a teaching and scoping model... not a refinery simulator"* and *"**A real
CDU is not reboiled.** It is a refluxed absorber stripped with open steam at
the bottom, with pump-around circuits removing heat down the column."*

**Do not call the current model refinery-grade merely because it converges.**

## The structural gap is smaller than it looks

`ColumnType::RefluxedAbsorber` **already exists in the solver enum**;
`RigorousColumn::distillation` is simply the only constructor and fixes a
reboiled column. The path to a structurally correct CDU is a constructor plus
steam-stripping and pump-around handling on existing solver machinery -- **not
new solver physics**. Scope that before assuming a rewrite.

## Required eventual outputs

naphtha; kerosene; diesel; atmospheric gas oil where represented; atmospheric
residue; stage profile; condenser duty; furnace/reboiler-equivalent duty;
pump-around duties; stripping-steam demand; conservation report.

Use **~20-50 assay-derived pseudocomponents**, not thousands of molecules.

## Out of scope for this pass (programme-wide)

Do not: port DWSIM UI or graphical flowsheet objects; port CAPE-OPEN unless a
concrete backend requirement exists; reproduce .NET class architecture; make
DWSIM depend on Outram-FOAM; solve thousands of molecular species in the CDU;
implement molecular reconstruction before assay/pseudocomponent CDU works; call
a converged model validated without reference evidence; hide conservation
errors; push to `main`.
title: Refinery: CDU fidelity
